description: This source file defines a utility class ProductImageSizeUtils for image resizing functions, including methods for resizing images with or without maintaining aspect ratio and with different quality hints.

classes.name: ProductImageSizeUtils
classes.description: Utility class for image resize functions, providing static methods for resizing BufferedImages with different options.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Performs a simple resize of the input image to specified width and height without preserving aspect ratio.

methods.name: resizeWithHint
methods.description: Resizes an image to target dimensions using specified rendering hints and an option for higher quality, with possible multi-step scaling.

methods.name: resizeWithRatio
methods.description: Resizes an image to fit within specified dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio, adjusting dimensions accordingly.
